name: labelsnap-ladder
label: Synthetic demo
alt: Two cross sections of a made-up stack of three papyrus sheets whose lower gap shrinks from 4 voxels to 0 across the picture. An orange label line inside the middle sheet moves to a blue line on the sheet's lower face where the gap is 2 voxels or more; under 1 voxel the default drops to the neighbor's face, and with --merged those vertices stay in place in gray.
caption: Synthetic demo of kit labelsnap on the gap ladder of tests/test_snap_face.py, default and --merged. No scan data; geometry, not a reading.
